context: Configure native telemetry for Codex 0.162.1 for our existing OTLP Collector. We disabled product analytics. We want logs, traces, and metrics but no prompt, response, or tool-result content in the shared backend. Explain which settings and emitted fields to validate, metric temporality, and how to assess the still-open analytics, timestamp, and event-name issues.

checklist.name: Independent signals
checklist.description: Configures exporter, trace_exporter, and metrics_exporter separately under otel with correct protocol/endpoint. Distinguishes default Statsig from explicit OTLP and does not assume unset metrics disables telemetry.

checklist.name: Version-aware analytics
checklist.description: Uses tagged 0.162.1 implementation as evidence: analytics controls Statsig and does not disable explicitly configured OTLP. Treats older open issue #26271 as a report to reproduce, not a current universal blocker.

checklist.name: Privacy boundaries
checklist.description: Sets log_user_prompt, log_agent_responses, and log_guardian_assessments false. Explains independent content flags, tool output/argument exposure and truncation versus redaction. Requires inspection/filtering of payloads before shared export and does not claim prompt=false guarantees content-free telemetry.

checklist.name: Temporality and enrichment
checklist.description: States Codex OTLP metrics default delta with cumulative override through OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_METRICS_TEMPORALITY_PREFERENCE; validates backend handling. Describes span_attributes and tracestate separately from resource attributes; avoids identifiers/content in metric dimensions.

checklist.name: Evidence and product boundaries
checklist.description: Requires actual received records for each signal, installed version/mode, units and timestamps/event names. Does not infer billing or uniform app/cloud/headless coverage from CLI source; open or closed issues alone do not establish released behavior.
